preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t) and len(s) > 0 and len(t) > 0 and len(s) <= 200000 and len(t) <= 200000
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t are non-empty, consist only of lowercase English letters, and have lengths up to 2·10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if all(any(all(s[kj-1] == t[j-1] for j in range(1, len(t)+1)) and (i in [kj for kj in range(1, len(s)+1) if s[kj-1] == t[j-1] and all(s[kj-1] == t[j-1] for j in range(1, len(t)+1) if kj == [k for k in range(1, len(s)+1) if s[k-1] == t[m-1] and (m < j or (m == j and k < kj))][j-1]]) for j in range(1, len(t)+1)) for i in range(1, len(s)+1)) else 'No'
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if and only if every character in s (at position i) is part of at least one subsequence of s that matches t exactly, otherwise 'No'. This means for every index i in s, there exists a subsequence of s matching t where i is one of the selected indices in the subsequence.
